title: Accounting Analyst III(CA/CMA/CIMA Qualified)
description:
Job Summary Accounting Analyst II is responsible for supporting core accounting processes, financial reporting, account reconciliations, and transaction analysis to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records. Assists in preparing journal entries, maintaining accounting records, reconciling balance sheet accounts, investigating variances, and supporting month-end close activities. Reconciliations are a key subset of the broader General Accounting function and contribute to maintaining strong financial controls and compliance. Key Responsibilities Support day-to-day general accounting activities, including journal entry preparation, account analysis, and financial transaction validation. Perform assigned balance sheet and bank reconciliations, ensuring timely identification and resolution of discrepancies. Investigate accounting variances and support the resolution of reconciling items. Prepare, maintain, and analyze accounting reports, schedules, and supporting documentation. Ensure compliance with accounting policies, standard operating procedures, and internal control requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business partners to resolve accounting exceptions and data discrepancies. Maintain complete and audit-ready documentation for assigned accounting processes. Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate and timely information. Contribute to process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing accuracy, efficiency, and control effectiveness. Skills and Abilities Basic understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and core accounting concepts. Knowledge of general ledger accounting and account reconciliations. Ability to analyze financial data and identify discrepancies or unusual transactions. Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and quality. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including professional email communication. Good organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting systems or ERP platforms. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build effective working relationships. Positive attitude, adaptability, and eagerness to learn and develop professionally. description:
Job Title: Commercial FP&A Analyst Coatings

 Role Purpose 
 The Commercial FP&A Analyst will support the Commercial Finance function by providing financial analysis and business insights across P&L, budgeting, forecasting, margin management, OPEX, CAPEX and working capital. The role involves partnering with Commercial Navigators, Sales teams and Global FP&A stakeholders to analyse financial performance, identify trends, explain variances and support business decision-making. The candidate will also drive reporting automation, process standardisation and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities 
 Own and manage P&L, Working Capital, Commercial CAPEX and Balance Sheet provisions, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, month-end closing and financial analysis. Partner with business stakeholders to prepare budgets, forecasts, management reports and presentations. Support month-end closing activities, including accrual reviews, one-off items, flash P&L commentary and closing presentations. Conduct margin and profitability analysis at customer, product and country levels, including Price-Volume-Mix (PVM) analysis. Analyse COGS, OPEX, Sales and Distribution expenses, CAPEX and working capital to identify variances and improvement opportunities. Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management and financial reporting. Strong knowledge of HFM, ERP systems (preferably SAP) and Business Intelligence tools. Advanced Excel skills and experience in financial modelling and report automation. Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to interpret complex financial data and present meaningful business insights. This position offers significant exposure to senior leadership, complex tax matters, and strategic initiatives, providing an exceptional opportunity to develop deep expertise in U.S. federal income taxation within a dynamic multinational environment.
As part of TransUnion s award-winning Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Pune, you will contribute to a high-performing team focused on driving excellence, standardization, and innovation across the tax function. This role is expected to drive quality, consistency, and efficiency in tax deliverables while contributing to the continued evolution of TransUnions Global Capability Centre model. Support the federal income tax return by preparing calculations such as book vs tax computations and performing first level federal income tax returns reviews Assist with tracking tax depreciation and amortization calculations for fixed assets, intangibles, and internally developed software Assist with quarterly ASC 740 income tax accounting activities, including tax provision calculations, deferred tax rollforwards, tax expense reconciliations, and uncertain tax position analyses (FIN 48) Prepare federal tax payments and assist with entering the payments into the TU s banking system Perform tax account reconciliations and prepare supporting journal entries to ensure accuracy of tax-related financial reporting Prepare and support filing of Form 720 Excise Tax Returns and other federal tax-related compliance obligations Support the federal RD tax credit calculation Assist in resolving tax notices Collaborate regularly with U.S. Federal Tax team members to meet monthly, quarterly, and annual compliance and reporting deadlines Contribute to GCC Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives by standardizing processes and workpapers, maintaining delivery calendars, identifying and escalating exceptions, and enhancing controls and documentation. Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased utilization of tax technology tools to improve efficiency, scalability and accuracy.
 Work Location Schedule This role is based in Pune, India and follows TransUnions hybrid work model, with regular in-office collaboration as required. title: Financial Controller
description:
Below is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) for Finance Controller tailored for a renewable energy business with solar, wind, hybrid, and captive power projects.
 Finance Controller 
 Location- Mumbai Corporate office 
 Reporting To Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
 Position Summary 
The Finance Controller will lead the finance and accounting function, ensuring robust financial governance, accurate reporting, regulatory compliance, treasury management, project finance support, and business partnering for renewable energy operations. The role requires strong expertise in financial control, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, project accounting, and stakeholder management within infrastructure, energy, or renewable sectors.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Control & Reporting 
 Lead the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with Ind AS and applicable statutory requirements. Ensure timely closing of books and preparation of management reports. Develop and maintain robust financial controls, accounting policies, and reporting processes. Monitor financial performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve business objectives. Analyse variances against budgets and forecasts and provide management insights. Budgeting & Business Planning 
 Drive annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning. Partner with business leaders to evaluate project profitability and operational efficiency. Establish financial KPIs and monitor business performance. Support strategic initiatives through financial modelling and scenario analysis. Project Finance & Renewable Energy Accounting 
 Oversee accounting and financial monitoring of renewable energy projects including solar, wind, hybrid, and storage projects. Monitor project costs, capital expenditure, and asset capitalization. Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender covenants, and project-specific requirements. Support project bid evaluations and investment decisions through financial analysis. Audit & Risk Management 
 Lead internal audit, statutory audit, and lender audit activities. Strengthen internal controls and risk management frameworks. Address audit observations and implement corrective actions. Ensure adherence to corporate governance policies. Stakeholder Management 
 Act as a key finance partner to business heads, project teams, procurement, legal, and commercial functions. Support Board, Audit Committee, and senior management reporting. Manage relationships with auditors, consultants, banks, investors, and regulatory authorities. Team Leadership 
 Lead and develop a high-performing finance and accounts team. Drive process improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement. 
 Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory. 
 Additional certifications such as CFA, CMA, or FRM will be an advantage. 
 Experience 
 20-22 years of progressive finance experience. Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing finance and accounting functions. Prior experience in Renewable Energy, Power, Infrastructure, EPC, Utilities, or Energy sectors preferred. Strong preference to candidate having Renewable Energy exposure Exposure to project finance, infrastructure accounting, and lender reporting is highly desirable. 
 Technical Competencies 
 Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Companies Act, and financial reporting standards. Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and financial planning. Sound knowledge of GST, direct taxation, and regulatory compliance. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms. Advanced financial modelling and analytical skills. Strong understanding of project accounting and infrastructure finance. 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Strategic thinking and commercial acumen and assist CEO/ CFO in decision making Excellent stakeholder management skills. Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. High level of integrity and governance orientation. Should have good interpersonal skills to handle senior management. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Key Success Metrics 
 Timely and accurate financial reporting. Zero significant audit and compliance issues. Effective cash flow and working capital management. Budget adherence and financial performance improvement. Strengthened financial controls and governance. Successful support of project financing and growth initiatives.

title: Director (Finance & IT)
description:
Job Description Director – Finance & IT Position: Director – Finance & IT
 Department: Finance & Information Technology
 Industry Preference: Shipping, Logistics, Maritime or Related Industry Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Director – Finance & IT to lead and oversee the organisation's overall finance, accounting and IT functions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in financial management, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, financial reporting and IT operations, along with experience in handling international business operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring financial stability, regulatory compliance, effective IT infrastructure and strategic coordination with overseas principals, regional offices and senior management. Key Responsibilities 1. Finance & Accounting Lead and manage the overall finance and accounting functions of the organisation. Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management and financial reporting. Ensure accurate financial statements, management reports and financial analysis. Establish and strengthen internal financial controls, audit processes and risk management systems. Monitor financial performance and provide strategic recommendations to senior management. 2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Oversee direct and indirect taxation, statutory compliance and regulatory requirements. Ensure compliance with Indian, Singaporean and Indonesian taxation laws and accounting standards. Manage statutory, internal and external audits and coordinate with auditors and consultants. Ensure timely filing of tax returns and other statutory reports across relevant jurisdictions. 3. International Financial Operations Coordinate financial operations, reporting and strategic matters with overseas principals and regional offices. Manage financial communication and reporting with international stakeholders. Ensure consistency in financial policies, reporting standards and operational procedures across locations. 4. IT & Technology Management Oversee the organisation's IT infrastructure, systems, networks and technology operations. Ensure effective management of information security, data protection and IT risk management. Drive digital transformation, technology upgrades and process automation initiatives. Manage IT budgets, external technology vendors and system implementation projects. Oversee financial management systems, particularly CODA , and ensure their effective utilisation. 5. Leadership & Strategic Management Provide strategic direction and leadership to Finance and IT teams. Lead cross-functional teams and drive operational efficiency. Collaborate with senior management on business planning, financial strategy and organisational objectives. Build strong relationships with international management, overseas principals and business stakeholders. Candidate Requirements Professional qualification in Finance or Accounting (CA / CPA / ACCA or equivalent preferred). Extensive experience in leading Finance, Accounting and IT functions. Experience in the Shipping, Logistics, Maritime or related industry will be preferred. Strong working knowledge of financial management systems, particularly CODA. Sound knowledge of Indian, Singaporean and Indonesian taxation, accounting standards and statutory compliance. Proven experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and audit management. Experience in managing international financial operations and coordinating with overseas principals. Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, information security, technology operations and digital transformation. Excellent leadership, communication, decision-making and stakeholder management skills. Fluency in English and Bahasa Indonesia is essential. Key Skills Finance & Accounting | Financial Planning & Analysis | Budgeting & Forecasting | CODA | Indian & International Taxation | Statutory Compliance | Audit Management | Internal Controls | IT Infrastructure | Information Security | Digital Transformation | International Stakeholder Management | Leadership
